prev_agent: Not exactly. The outer Canvas pane is capped at **55%**, not 50%, and that percentage is of the `TerminalLayout` container, not necessarily the raw viewport. Source: [terminal-layout.tsx](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyork/web/src/features/home/pages/terminal-layout.tsx:9) sets `CANVAS_MAX_PERCENT = 55`, and the drag math clamps to that at [terminal-layout.tsx](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyork/web/src/features/home/pages/terminal-layout.tsx:160). There’s also an inner resizable split inside the Files tab. The file-tree side is capped at **55% of the Canvas pane**: [canvas-panel.tsx](/Users/tanishqpalandurkar/Projects/yyork/web/src/features/home/components/organisms/canvas-panel.tsx:87). One caveat: stored `canvasLayout` values are not clamped on read, so manual/localStorage state could render outside that range.
